form.style:
Lo-fi Remix, articulation, Korean Lo-fi R&B, 80 BPM, key Eb Major, Felt Piano-led, soft shaker, hazy ambient pad, cinematic but restrained.
Male vocal: warm soulful tone, dry close-mic, slightly breathy, straight delivery, minimal vibrato, minimal autotune.
No backing vocals, no harmonies, no doubles, no choir.
Lead vocal only throughout; absolutely no vocal layers in chorus (no doubles, no unison, no octaves).
Chorus hook-first, repeat identical; Chorus2 bigger only by arrangement density and stereo width, vocals unchanged.
Verse2 same melodic contour as verse1; last 2 lines stronger dynamics and slightly higher register, minimal runs.
Bridge builds every bar with instrumental layers; no energy drop into chorus.
Outro felt piano notes fading into silence.
form.exclude: choir, gospel choir, stacked harmonies, vocal harmonies, harmony stack, ensemble vocals, doubled vocals, vocoder, vocal chop, hard tune, pitchy EDM lead, hyperpop vocal, autotune heavy, EDM drops, big room, festival, supersaw lead, sidechain pumping

=== META ===
Track 16 of the 23:00 series (temporary number). The STYLE is the original 물안개 song's STYLE with the Lo-fi Remix prefix, and the EXCLUDE is its original list, both used byte for byte from the final-styles record (concept.md ## Original Styles); BPM 80, Key Eb Major and the male vocal come from that original STYLE (젠: 「원곡 BPM 그대로」, 「원곡대로 남성」). The lyric is original wording on the type original's lyric frame (row count, tag lines, per-row syllable counts and repeated rows); the type's reference remix lyric supplied only that frame. No generated audio exists in this repository for duration, tempo, key, vocal, or arrangement verification.
